items.text: Max Solomon is an attorney. He has worked as an adjunct political science instructor. He served as a trustee of the Grande Prairie Public Library District.

sentences.text: He has worked as an adjunct political science instructor.
He served as a trustee of the Grande Prairie Public Library District.

items.text: His top priorities include creating a real-time public dashboard for state funds. He has proposed modernizing the state's investment strategy to maximize returns. He also supports strengthening the Bright Start and Bright Directions college savings programs. In a 2024 candidate questionnaire, he supported constitutional pension reform and tax relief measures. He also supported independent redistricting commissions and called for deterring corruption through prosecution. In 2022, he said he believed "life begins before we were formed" and that he did not believe Joe Biden was rightfully elected president in 2020.
